scientific_integrity: Proof and reproducibility code accompany this result. Gaussian/Wishart and special-function ingredients are classical. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real symmetric operator, an eigenvector pair, swapped two-mode unit candidates, shared i.i.d. Gaussian row sketch, separate one-dimensional quotient estimates, theta strictly between zero and pi/4. This is not a general joint-projected Ritz eigenvalue theorem; large-row asymptotics fix overlap. Literature comparisons do not establish independent publication priority.
title: Exact ranking inversion law for paired one-dimensional sketched Rayleigh quotients
